decisions.reason: Reducing the trial assignment to one reference-matching clip does not cancel or change the standard for selecting substantive, valuable moments.
The source changes the trial assignment and source constraint but does not alter the requirement that each clip form a complete, independently understandable narrative.
The request for one clip matching the supplied reference neither reinstates nor modifies any hook-quality attribute.
Changing the number and reference basis of the trial clips does not change the existing 20–120 second duration bounds.

The same-message requirement to match the supplied design reference is already represented by the existing MODIFY, and the source-selection change requires no additional visual-style update or removal.
The existing message-143 MODIFY already replaces the eight-clip revision assignment with one reference-matching trial clip; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.
The source does not change the white-text-only or no-text-effects standards.
The one-clip trial request does not modify the separate ongoing target of 180 approved clips per month.
The request to match a supplied reference does not explicitly replace or modify the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
